message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on facts: The defendant found a phone and then used Alipay small amount password-free payment to steal 3723 RMB from victim's Alipay account. This is theft (盗窃) of electronic funds. In Chinese criminal law, this could be "盗窃罪" (theft) specifically "利用信息网络盗窃公私财物" maybe "利用信息网络盗窃罪". Also could be "非法获取他人金融账户信息罪"? Under Chinese law, there is "非法获取金融账户信息罪" (刑法第176条) but that is about obtaining account info. Here he used the victim's phone to access Alipay and transferred money. That is theft via electronic means, qualifies as "盗窃罪" (theft). Could also be "诈骗罪"? He didn't deceive victim; he just used the phone to transfer money. So theft.

Also "侵犯公民个人信息罪"? He used victim's phone to get info. But the fact only says he stole money via Alipay. The direct crime is theft. Could be "非法获取公民个人信息罪" (刑法第253条) if he obtained personal info. But the fact doesn't mention obtaining info, just using phone. The main crime: theft (盗窃罪). Possibly "诈骗罪" not appropriate.

Thus answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>
